verdict.rationale: Meilisearch lists first-party connectors that sync data automatically instead of a hand-built pipeline: Meilisync for MySQL, PostgreSQL and MongoDB, Firebase collection sync, Rails ActiveRecord auto-sync, and a first-party Laravel Scout driver. Evidence for each is a one-line integration-page claim, and one production user reports the Rails gems falling out of step with the server. Missing for 10: any official web crawler/scraper for site content, in-depth docs on connector setup and sync behavior, and independent hands-on confirmation that the connectors work reliably.
